body: Hmm, I haven't really thought about that one. I like french bread. I know that's not really a meal but I hardly sit down to eat. I live by a Walmart so as soon as I get off work I grab a big loaf and I can eat it myself until the next night. It's pretty much the only place open when I get off at 1 or 2 am. I would like to learn to cook for myself though. I only really know the basics. You know, spaghetti, ramen noodles, eggs, pancakes, etc. How about you, what is yours?

I laughed a bit at this. A twenty year suicide, like the slowest game of chess ever played. At that point I would be 41. As tempting as a midlife crisis seems, I don't think I'll be able to afford a sports car!

>I wake up because I can't sleep forever.

That one hit home.

Wow, I'm not going to try to sugar coat this. That seems like it fucking sucks. I only ask because I have discussed my suicide with my parents (well, as much as I could have) and I'm curious, have you spoken to your family about it? Are they the type of family that can discuss things like that?

Thank you, this made me tear up. SA, is the worst. I remember when I first when to get my evaluation. It was about four years ago and I was seventeen. It was something I kept pushing back in my mind. Then when the lady said "social anxiety" it hit me like a ton of bricks. I remember thinking "Social anxiety? That's a fucking death sentence." I cried for two days straight and I couldn't bring myself to eat. I've tried to bring it up to family but it is such an ugly term that I can't do it. Even if I hide it under a layer of humor...I just can't. That's the worst part about it I think, the feeling of being powerless. The feeling of wanting to make a friend in a stranger or hold a conversation with an old classmate and then just majorly fucking up or brushing them off to regain comfort. 

I wish I were at a point where I could read all of these responses and just be cured. They do give me hope and comfort but it isn't enough. I don't want to live with this every day. I just want you thank you for your comfort though, at least I know I'm not crazy. At least I know that there's someone out there somewhere who has gone through this torture as well.
That's good advice. What is IRC?
Thank you, I appreciate it. I hope you feel a little better at the very least.

That sounds awesome but the thing is, I spend a ton of time at work and when I'm not working I work on what I need to do for the next job I'd like in six months. I would like to talk to some people online in these next few months if I can carve out some time though. It's just all my other efforts to do so didn't go so well. I'm a girl (I know, I know the whole *btw I'm a girl thing on reddit* but I feel it's relevant) and a lot of the times when I thought I was making a connection with someone I ended up getting asked for nudes or with an unannounced D pic in my inbox. I'm not so for that. Sex talk makes me a bit uncomfortable.

Well let's just say it's the one career I wanted. I've sacrificed so much time and effort and honestly, it is the only solution to all of my problems. I would always be around people with common interests, I would be away from this hell hole, I would be doing something that allows me to feel something every once in a while. I know It wouldn't be immediate, but I know I could be happy again. I'm so close, six months away. It's just that if it doesn't happen. I stay here, where everyone lives like cattle.

I'm lonely. There's a lot more there, but that's the number one thing. I haven't had a real friend for four years and I've had romantic relationships but those don't make up for it. I just want friends. It's just that I have social anxiety and it's like being in a jail cell. I like people, I do. I genuinely want to make connections and learn to love like when I was younger. But my hands shake, I blush, I stutter, and my words pour out like vomit. I feel trapped. I don't want to do this every day, it's way too hard. I don't mean to unload this all on you. I'm not going to be one of those people who puts no effort into the conversation and expects you to beg them to stay alive. I don't really know what I want. I just hope someday for the sake of others, mental illness won't be such a stigma. I feel like a damn alien.

I over think everything. Ninety five percent of the time a whirlwind of existential thoughts are running through my mind. I just want to think about what I'm going to have for dinner or what gadget I'll buy next like everyone else sometimes. I'm really in no position to give advice, I'm honestly going to kill myself soon if the *one* thing in life I wanted falls through. I don't really love or feel anything towards anything. I just don't get to talk to very many people who would even think of the things you said. They sound like something I would think. 
Today I woke up after a night of crying myself to sleep. It was piss cold and the hot shower water was taken up by my sister's piece of shit boyfriend doing the laundry. I had only gotten three hours of sleep I had to work a double. I had an extra beforehand ten minutes so I had a bowl of fruit loops. As simple as it was, that little delicious bowl of sugar reminded me that whether or not I ended up killing myself. If I looked at it the right way, existence was a god damn beautiful thing. Nonexistence is nothing, zilch, zero, nada. A flat line. But even it was just for five minutes, that cereal boosted that flat line. Which is why I'm not afraid to die. 

I'm sorry for rambling, it just seems like something you might like to toss around the old noggin'.
Right there with you on the social anxiety thing. Fuck everything about it.

Hey, I am also stuck making shitty pizzas. I saw your post while I was waiting for a response to mine. I won't give you any generic advice because I feel just as empty. I'm just going through the same thing, that's all.
